data.name: Sadeed
data.gender_notes: Sadeed is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root s-d-d which means 'to be sincere, to speak the truth'. The name Sadeed is used to describe someone who is truthful and sincere in their words and actions. The name Sadeed carries the meaning “Truthful, Sincere” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Sadeed usually hope their child will grow to embody truthful, sincere and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes sincerity and truthfulness in one's actions and words.
data.etymology: Sadeed belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Truthful, Sincere.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sadeed total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
